Prototype flows

The captured screens linked into a clickable prototype — desktop and mobile web — stored by product section. Every link on a template leads to the template it would open on live (or says “Not part of this prototype”), and the dropdowns, dialogs and sheets open from the control that opens them on live. A representative jump lands on the one captured example of that screen type (every car ad opens the captured car ad). Generated 2026-10-06 · 7 consumer sections · 93 screens · 1426 transitions · agency portal 30 screens / 142 transitions.
